title: 4 Planes. 4,000 km. Every Light Off.
desc:
In July 1976, four Israeli Hercules flew into Uganda with every light switched off. 106 hostages were waiting in an old airport terminal.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: How 4 Hijackers Took a Jet in 3 Minutes (1976)
desc:
A broken metal detector in Athens let four hijackers board Air France 139 with pistols and grenades. Minutes after takeoff, the plane was theirs.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: She Lied to the Hijackers, and It Worked
desc:
On the ground in Libya, one passenger said she was losing her baby. They let her go. She wasn't.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: The Dictator Was Already Waiting for the Hijacked Plane
desc:
Flight 139 landed at Entebbe at 3:15 a.m. with no argument from the tower. Did Idi Amin know it was coming?
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: Then They Started Reading the Passports…
desc:
At Entebbe, the hijackers split the Israeli and Jewish hostages from everyone else. For the older hostages, it brought back Europe thirty years earlier.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: The Captain Who Refused to Be Freed
desc:
The hijackers offered to release the Air France crew. Captain Michel Bacos said no: his passengers were still there, so his crew stayed too.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: The Mistake That Doomed the Hijackers
desc:
Freeing 100+ hostages looked like mercy. In Paris, Israeli agents asked every one of them about the terminal.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: Israel's First Rescue Plan Had a Crocodile Problem 🐊
desc:
Plan one: cross Lake Victoria by boat. Nobody had written down the crocodiles. All three early plans got in, and none got out.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: They Had the Blueprints of the Enemy Airport
desc:
An Israeli company had built Entebbe's old terminal. Its engineers still had every plan, so the commandos built a copy and rehearsed.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: Flying Under 3 Countries' Radar
desc:
Four Hercules flew down the Red Sea just above the waves, under Egyptian, Sudanese and Saudi radar, all the way to Uganda.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: The Fake Mercedes That Almost Worked
desc:
Israel copied Idi Amin's black Mercedes to drive right up to the terminal. They didn't know he had just bought a white one.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: The Commander Was the First to Fall
desc:
One shot ended the surprise. Yoni Netanyahu led the assault team at Entebbe and was hit outside the terminal before the raid had really begun.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: The Raid Took 30 Minutes
desc:
102 hostages rescued, 11 MiGs destroyed, about 90 minutes on the ground and roughly 30 of fighting.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: The Hostage Who Never Came Home
desc:
Dora Bloch, 75, was taken to a Kampala hospital before the raid. Years later, British records and a Ugandan inquiry said she was killed on Amin's orders.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Entebbe #OperationThunderbolt #History #3DAnimation #HistoryReels

title: His Brother Became Prime Minister
desc:
The raid was renamed Operation Yonatan after the one commando who died. His younger brother Benjamin later became Israel's prime minister.
